description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 01508/1-4/P7 to allow for replacement of 7th floor balconies in Blocks A & B with two roof terraces; slimmer profile brick pier detail to Block C; installation of external, recessed aluminium RWPs on building elevations; removal of residents' gym; amendments to window openings to accommodate structure and brick dimensions; Block A2 entrance at lower ground floor level optimised to allow for more efficient use of space; addition of lift over runs to the drawings; addition of coping to roof parapets; addition of an external staircase from lower ground floor to upper ground floor on Block C; amendment of louvre location to the rear elevation; addition of recessed louvres and brick recess above all windows; replacement of glass balconies with metal railings; addition of pedestrian guarding to car park entrance at lower ground floor level; removal of winter gardens, absorption of winter garden floorspace into dwellings, and addition of bolt-on balconies; amendments to stair/lift core configuration; amendments to position of fire duct equipment; minor reconfiguration of internal flat layouts.
